# Telem AI

Route agent web searches and inspect the traces.

## Web Search Router

One API across search providers. Route each agent query to the best engine by cost, latency, and answer quality — with automatic failover when a provider degrades.

## Web Fetch Router

Resilient page retrieval for agents. Rendering, retries, and clean extraction handled for you — hand your model readable content, not raw HTML.

## Observability

See what your agents actually do. Traces, traffic, and judged quality metrics across every project — live in the Telem console today.

## Read the docs

Drop-in APIs with sane defaults. Point your agent at one endpoint, get routing, retries, and telemetry without changing your stack.

## Simple pricing

ZERO additional charge. Unlike the OpenRouter business model, you pay the upstream provider’s per-request rate for every search and fetch Telem routes — routing, tracing, and the observability console add no platform fee on top.

## Why Telem

Agents are only as good as the substrate they run on. Telem AI builds the layer between your agents and the open web: routing every search and fetch to the best provider, and observing every step so you can trust what ships.
